description: This is the kind of music that makes skeletons dance. With its pounding brass, singsong flute melody, and off-kilter syncopation, this piece is whimsical and reminiscent of a carnival. It is quirky, quick, playful, and dangerously creepy, and is perfect for a lively cartoon, circus-themed content, or a magician?s show.
instruments: Accordion, Violin, Percussion, Flutes, Trumpets, Horns, Strings
title: One-eyed Maestro
